title: Minimax ATE Estimation over Discrete Cells with Shrinking Effect Heterogeneity
banked_reason: The stated project promises the sharp shrinking-radius frontier, but this theorem supplies only a strict upper-envelope tightening and explicitly leaves the residual wedge (including the benchmark) open.
gap_reasons: The stated project promises the sharp shrinking-radius frontier, but this theorem supplies only a strict upper-envelope tightening and explicitly leaves the residual wedge (including the benchmark) open; it must be positioned and routed as a partial frontier result rather than the promised resolution.

At d=n and sigma^2=log^2(en)/n, neither closed-region condition holds. The outer separation bracket remains logarithmically nonmatching, and the conditionally centered marked-score program is not specified tightly enough to decide whether super-parametric separation is feasible.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved a total empirical-mass correction and a collision-scale result on a strict subregion, and it killed the simplest globally shifted marked-prior construction at the benchmark. It could not construct the supportwise shared-design converse or a matching stabilized upper estimator across the residual wedge, so the promised sharp full frontier remained open.
tldr: The kernel is the finite-sample minimax MSE frontier for an identified ATE when high-dimensional discrete adjustment cells have effects within a calibrated maximal radius \(\sigma M\) of the ATE.  The exact split-sample empirical-mass estimator gives collision-scale risk \(M^2/n\) for \(2\le d\le n\) when \(\sigma^2d^2\le n\), while the inherited rare-cell approximation branch gives the same rate when \(u_{n,d}\le n^{-1}\), equivalently \(d^2\le n\log^2(en)\).  Thus approximate common effects retain collision-scale estimation on the union of these two directly checkable regions.  At the still-unresolved benchmark \(d=n\), \(\sigma^2=\log^2(en)/n\), an exactly normalized shared-design marked family fails because its global outcome shift makes the full mixtures distinguishable; the conditionally centered marked-coupling repair remains open, and no global frontier formula is asserted.
gap: The closest archival paper gives binary-outcome unrestricted and exact-homogeneity endpoints and explicitly leaves maximal-radius dependence unresolved; the accepted same-class parent narrows the issue to nonmatching rates.
fill: The project establishes the empirical-mass collision subregion with a completely specified total estimator, falsifies the first exactly normalized shared-design prior at the decisive benchmark, and reduces the open lower-bound work to a conditionally centered marked-coupling repair.
